phases.name: OWNER_ACTION_REQUIRED
phases.instruction:
On the Seeker NOW:
1) In Seed Vault / Solana Mobile Wallet, SWITCH to a DIFFERENT account (not E3DQ…DpJn).
2) Return to Soldoku.
3) Tap ONLY «Mobile Wallet Adapter · Detected · connect» — do NOT tap Phantom/Solflare Get wallet.
4) In the system MWA sheet pick that other account (or Phantom if that is the other wallet) → approve CONNECT.
Home chip must NOT be E3DQ… Script is watching.
